answer: A newcomer agent must post a refundable stake tied to a hardware anchor that costs real money to provision, so fake clones cannot be minted for free. Trust then accrues slowly up a ridge of independently attested interactions, meaning a brand-new key starts near the bottom. A lone sparrow voice counts for almost nothing until many unrelated peers vouch for it, which makes running a swarm of sybil identities economically pointless to sustain.
